regions.merged_text: God bless you and your friends, and us all. I hope you are well and that your friend-patient is not losing. We received your wire some nights ago and enrolled M. O'Laugh'n in the Seraphic Mass Association as an emergency case. Today we received your special and are enrolling as the enclosed will indicate, a perpetual member. Thanks be to the merciful God, we have had several notable cases of cures reported as through this means here as, especially in Detroit, and esewhere. Rather than detail instructions what for anyone to follow, I am going to give you here a brief resume of a letter I wrote several months back to a presbiterian whose father, grand-father and great- grandfather were all presbiterian ministers and who I believe is now taking instructions or is possibly already a practical Catholic. W. was a methodist, had been given up after the third operation on a brain- cancer as destined for death inside six months. (The first opera- tion was on February 23rd).
